操作步骤：
1. 先用 Read 工具读取该文件全文。
2. 用 Edit 工具做最小改动：在每题**原始回答文本之后、下一题 "# question N" 标题之前**，各插入一个 callout（每行以 "> " 开头，含首行 "> [!tip] 修改版范文"）。共四处插入。**原始回答文本、题目文字、frontmatter 一律不得改动，一个字都不要改。**

需要插入的四段内容如下（照抄，包括其中的标点）：

【Q1】在 Q1 原始回答（以 "…I was moved by their frienship." 结尾的那段）之后插入：
> [!tip] 修改版范文
> The last book I've read is Harry Potter, and I really enjoyed it. The main reason is the story itself — it's an adventure about Harry, Ron, and Hermione exploring the magical world, and it taught me to be brave. For example, when Harry stood up to Voldemort, I realized that courage matters more than talent. Another reason is the characters. They feel so real that I was deeply moved by their friendship, especially when Ron and Hermione always stood by Harry in danger. That's why I love this book.

【Q2】在 Q2 原始回答（以 "…So reading fictions is really a relaxing choice for me." 结尾的那段）之后插入：
> [!tip] 修改版范文
> I would definitely prefer fiction. For one thing, fiction is a lot of fun — when I dive into a story, I can follow the characters and forget about my daily stress completely. For another, I think fiction helps me understand the world better, because good stories come from real life and real emotions. On top of that, I admire the authors' imagination; they build wonderful worlds that I could never create myself. So for me, reading fiction is both relaxing and rewarding.

【Q3】在 Q3 原始回答（以 "…So in conclusion, I think printed books won't disappear." 结尾的那段）之后插入：
> [!tip] 修改版范文
> I don't think digital books will completely take the place of printed books. First, printed books are still needed in education. Many schools require students to use physical textbooks, and young children shouldn't spend too much time on screens anyway. Second, many readers simply prefer the feel of paper books. Turning real pages helps people concentrate and feel more immersed in the story, while screens can easily distract you with notifications. So I believe printed books will continue to exist, even if digital books become more popular.

【Q4】在 Q4 原始回答（以 "…Besides, we can make friends with same interest by this way." 结尾的那段）之后插入：
> [!tip] 修改版范文
> I totally agree that joining a book club can enhance the reading experience. First, discussing a book with others gives you new perspectives. Personally, I'm always excited to hear others' thoughts, because they often point out details I completely missed, which deepens my understanding of the story and characters. Second, a book club is a great way to make friends who share the same interests — we can talk about books, exchange recommendations, and even read together. So I think a book club makes reading much more rewarding.
